protocol: One Time-owned nonretrying local SQL transaction for approve, withdraw and import bank effects.
Separate Contracts context uses the same open connection/transaction and preserves module API, audit and outbox ownership.
Read-own-writes billing terms; month locks, financial application lock, rows and bank effects in that order.
Same database and SQL identity required; existing unowned transactions, active retry callbacks and inbox handlers cannot bind.
Unexpected historical receipts, including closed/depleted/deleted bank entries, require Finance review; validated completed legacy refunds are not repeated.

limits: This is affected SQL coverage, not the complete CRM integration suite.
Atomicity covers one CRM SQL database and the explicit Time/Contracts command boundary only.
Legacy financial history needs separate Finance reconciliation before a financial pilot.
Export-to-invoiced asynchronous delivery remains the next financial boundary.
Upgrade all Web/Worker writers as a stopped cohort; arbitrary DBA writes and offline restore bypass application admission.
Working providers, Entra and Hostinger VPS are not verified by synthetic local tests.
